deliverables.prompt: Create a sophisticated cinematic visual for Devobs AI Intelligence: a believable dark professional DevOps control room with legible code-like dashboards, CI signals and human approval status, minimalist black and gold accents. Do not depict invented performance statistics, third-party logos, user secrets, real incidents, or claims that the production SaaS is live. Leave text space for an Arabic headline; make no actual Arabic text in the image.
